label: Effects of auricular vagal neuromodulation therapy combined with slow-paced diaphragmatic breathing in individuals with postural tachycardia syndrome: a randomised controlled trial protocol.
summary: Postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome (POTS) is a multifactorial disorder of the autonomic nervous system characterised by an excessive increase in heart rate (HR) on standing and a wide range of debilitating symptoms, including fatigue, exercise intolerance, cognitive impairment and a high prevalence of depression, anxiety and sleep disturbances.
